column1: # ZAP rules for make dast (scripts/security/dast.sh; docs/designs/devsecops.md "Blocking policy").
# <rule id> TAB <FAIL|WARN|IGNORE> TAB <name; risk or reason>. Every rule ZAP 2.17.0 runs in the
# API and baseline scans is listed: High and Medium are FAIL, Low and Informational WARN, except
# where the reason says otherwise. A rule not listed defaults to WARN, so a new rule from a ZAP bump
# is added here. Never IGNORE a rule here: an accepted finding goes in security/allow.json, with
# its reason and expiry, and dast.sh turns its live ids into IGNORE, or a scoped id
# (<rule>@<url regex>) into an OUTOFSCOPE line for that URL only.
